shared_elements: carved relief on an upright slab/monolith
incised linear motifs covering the surface
justification: Both are upright carved surfaces bearing an anthropomorphic presence and incised motifs organized into rough horizontal zones, but that is about as generic as a correspondence gets. A shows a narrative scene of two profile human figures facing each other across an offering stand above dense rows of small script-like signs, rendered in fine low relief with naturalistic limbs; B is a massive frontal figure-shaped block whose surface bears large, bold, abstract curvilinear and circular motifs with no profile figures, no offering scene and no rows of small signs.
